prompt:
Yes, ship now, whatever is needed. That's interesting. If you have a template for the issues, so it would be basically compatible for each of the potential installation that we would have on this system. And it's also interesting to have inside of the action one a way to actually report, which is interesting. And for action number three about waking an evaluation seat, when it awakens, it would fix and ship a patch of anything, you know, when it's something minor that needs just patching, and I would be communicated with if this is a major or if there is any risk. So if that makes sense, I think you could proceed in that direction. And I would probably influence your action number four on the decision cards. You know, it would be interesting to know which decision of what needs patching and is minor to fix and ship automatically. So it would imply setting yourself up to react to new issues on the repositories, and also ensure that that doesn't die if we reboot the system. So there should be something that we think about for continuity in terms of supporting this type of receiving feedback from the community on installation. And it should also be short time, like for the next 2 weeks or something. And it should be reinstallable and modulable for future feedback that we would actually be wanting to receive, basically, which right now there's that one. And it was might be feedback as well on the musical part of the installations. And we should support as well, maybe replying to issues if there are questions, or there might be also, yes, feedback on the installation, but there might be also questions on the whole system that could help us clarify and, you know, do documentation upgrades or simple reply to issues to foster some automation here. And we would also ensure that we use a decision engine or something to use the cheapest model and you know, but not the cheapest, but, you know, choose the right model. Episode 564 is developing stuff for choosing about that, which might help us here on this little adventure that we're thinking of doing. So I think that your recommendation for shipping is good, and also what I talked about here should help you advance to the next step and get ready.

ambiguities.text: "react to new issues on the repositories" does not name the repositories
ambiguities.suggestion: Default to jgwill/miadi-orchestration-kit plus the repo that holds packages/miadi/deb, listed in the feedback-channel config

ambiguities.text: "inside of the action one a way to actually report" could mean printing a bundle or filing the issue
ambiguities.suggestion: Have miadi-config report print the bundle and open a prefilled issue URL, with gh issue create when gh is authenticated

ambiguities.text: Minor versus major or risky has no stated threshold
ambiguities.suggestion: Minor: docs, packaging metadata, dependency pins, scripts with no data or security effect. Major or risky: security, data loss, breaking change, apt repository signing, anything touching shared infra

ambiguities.text: "ship a patch" for a deb package can mean commit, rebuild, or publish to the apt repository the outside developer pulls from
ambiguities.suggestion: Treat commit, version bump, rebuild and apt publish as the minor ship path, and escalate when the apt publish step fails or changes signing

ambiguities.text: "short time, like for the next 2 weeks or something" gives no exact expiry or end behaviour
ambiguities.suggestion: Expire on 2026-11-12, stop the timer, and post a summary of handled issues to Guillaume

ambiguities.text: "maybe replying to issues" leaves open whether replies post automatically to a human audience
ambiguities.suggestion: Post replies to plain factual questions automatically and send drafts for opinion, roadmap or commitment questions as decision cards

ambiguities.text: "a decision engine or something" and Episode 564's readiness are unknown
ambiguities.suggestion: Read Episode 564 first and fall back to a small rule table (task class to model) in the config if its engine is not usable yet

ambiguities.text: "might be feedback as well on the musical part" is hedged
ambiguities.suggestion: Include music as a feedback type in the template and config now, with no separate seat behaviour

ambiguities.text: "modulable for future feedback" does not define the unit of modularity
ambiguities.suggestion: One config file per feedback channel, installed and removed by a script, read by the same watcher

ambiguities.text: A5 ceremony path timing is left open
ambiguities.suggestion: Hold A5 until the two-week window closes and its summary exists
